title: Guided ACP planning intake with selectable project context
intent: Let user start planning from an ACP session that explicitly selects project, repository, working directory, docs, and prior context before the first prompt is sent.
acceptance: start screen exposes agent, cwd, project, repo, docs, mode, and model selectors
selected context is shown before session creation
session creation writes trace linkage through service layer
web does not assemble persistence payloads directly
anti_patterns: prompt-only planning with no source context list
web route importing ORM or repository classes
manual_simulation: Create plan from two docs and one repo, then verify the ACP prompt context drawer names all three sources before send.
incentive: reduces planning drift from missing source material

title: Resumable ACP planning sessions with visible reconnect state
intent: Preserve long-running planning sessions across reloads, offline transitions, and agent restarts while showing exactly whether Fulcrum is connected, reconnecting, or blocked.
acceptance: session list shows only sessions that support resume
manual reconnect action appears after transport loss
startup and reconnect phases are visible
resume keeps trace id and selected context stable
manual_simulation: Start ACP planning, reload browser, resume saved session, send follow-up, and confirm same trace id remains attached.
incentive: keeps planning cycles durable instead of chat-window fragile

title: Permission review dialog for tool calls with task-aware consequences
intent: Before an ACP tool call mutates files, tasks, docs, or runs, show a permission dialog that names the tool, target locations, affected task tree, and allow/reject choices.
acceptance: permission request includes tool title, kind, locations, and trace subject
choices support allow once, allow always for scoped action, reject once, reject always
rejection returns structured reason to ACP bridge
mutation permission never bypasses application service policy
manual_simulation: Ask agent to update a prototype file, reject once, and verify no artifact or task state changes occurred.
incentive: makes agent autonomy reviewable before irreversible actions

title: ACP traffic inspector with searchable JSON-RPC timeline
intent: Expose a dockable traffic panel for ACP requests, responses, notifications, errors, and permissions so planning failures can be debugged without log spelunking.
acceptance: traffic panel filters by direction, type, method, and error
entries can expand raw JSON and copy payload
pause and clear controls do not lose persisted audit events
sensitive values are redacted according to policy
manual_simulation: Trigger a failed ACP method, filter by error, copy payload, and verify trace and redaction are present.
incentive: shortens diagnosis of failed planning sessions

title: Submit-plan review gate with approve-or-feedback semantics
intent: Convert generated plans into an explicit review step where no annotations means approval and any annotation becomes structured feedback for another planning iteration.
acceptance: plan cannot proceed to task breakdown without approved status
feedback resubmits to the same planning session with prior annotations
approval records reviewer, timestamp, and trace id
CLI and TUI expose equivalent approve/feedback commands
anti_patterns: feedback stored only as chat text
manual_simulation: Submit flawed plan, annotate missing prototype target, request changes, resubmit, approve, and verify task breakdown is now enabled.
incentive: prevents document-only plans from becoming executable work prematurely

title: Prototype artifact review beside technical plan text
intent: Require planning cycles to show prototype or boilerplate artifacts next to the plan so user reviews intended behavior, not only prose.
acceptance: plan review includes artifact list with preview state
prototype artifacts can be annotated independently from text
approval requires all required prototype artifacts to be reviewed or explicitly waived
artifact preview uses workflow-coordination service
anti_patterns: plan says prototype exists but no preview
manual_simulation: Generate a UI plan with a prototype screenshot, annotate visual gap, and confirm feedback points to artifact id plus plan section.
incentive: turns planning into testable intent

title: Unified annotations for plan text, prototypes, UAT, and code review
intent: Use one annotation model across planning documents, prototype previews, UAT evidence, and code diffs so feedback loops are consistent and exportable.
acceptance: annotation stores subject kind, source path or artifact id, range, severity, label, and text
feedback export groups annotations by subject and status
same service supports plan, artifact, UAT, and code review sessions
resolved annotations remain visible in history
manual_simulation: Create one plan annotation and one prototype annotation, export feedback, and verify both appear in a single structured payload.
incentive: makes feedback reusable by agents and humans

title: Docked review workbench with file tree, feedback panel, and agent logs
intent: Provide a Plannotator-style review layout with navigable files/artifacts, annotation panel, agent job logs, and final approval controls.
acceptance: workbench shows file/artifact tree and selected review panel
agent logs update without rerendering annotation state
approval controls stay visible but disabled until blocking feedback is addressed
layout persists per user
anti_patterns: single long page of review content
manual_simulation: Open review with 30 files and live logs, add annotation, wait for log update, and verify annotation panel state does not reset.
incentive: keeps complex review loops usable at real project scale

title: Local diff code review loop with structured feedback export
intent: Let user review generated code changes in Fulcrum using local diff sources, inline annotations, and exported feedback sent back to the responsible agent run.
acceptance: review can load unstaged, staged, branch, or PR-equivalent diff
inline comments preserve file path and line range
feedback export schedules a follow-up agent run
approval records diff base and head identifiers
manual_simulation: Create a local change, open code review, annotate one line, send feedback, and verify follow-up run references exact path and range.
incentive: closes the code review loop before merge-quality claims

title: User acceptance testing session with evidence capture
intent: After automated QA passes, prompt user into a UAT session that captures manual steps, observations, artifacts, approval, or feedback.
acceptance: UAT session lists scenarios derived from success criteria
user can mark pass, fail, blocked, or needs evidence
evidence links to screenshots, logs, artifacts, or notes
approval can trigger real-data E2E generation task
manual_simulation: Complete two UAT scenarios, fail one with feedback, and verify automated feedback loop is scheduled instead of final approval.
incentive: turns user acceptance into durable regression input

title: Automated QA feedback loop exhaustion gate
intent: Prevent user UAT prompts until task agents, QA agents, and review agents have exhausted configured automated feedback loops or declared a blocked state.
acceptance: gate shows pending automated feedback runs and latest verdicts
UAT button disabled while retryable QA feedback exists
blocked state requires reason and owner
approval path records why automation is exhausted
anti_patterns: manual UAT before failing QA is processed
manual_simulation: Force QA failure, confirm UAT is disabled, then exhaust feedback attempts and verify UAT unlock explains final state.
incentive: keeps humans from reviewing work automation already knows is bad

title: Run task dependency tree from board or task action
intent: Before running an agent for a task or board selection, show the dependency tree that will be executed and require confirmation for the complete impact.
acceptance: run action previews ordered dependencies and blocked nodes
confirmation creates trace-linked execution plan
user can choose selected task only or full dependency tree when safe
execution records skipped and blocked reasons
anti_patterns: single task run silently ignoring dependencies
manual_simulation: Run a task with two prerequisites and one blocked dependency; verify preview, ordered execution, and blocked reason.
incentive: makes agent execution match project-management truth

title: Approved plan materializes tasks with success criteria and trace links
intent: On plan approval, create docs, tasks, dependencies, artifacts, and success criteria from the approved plan through application services.
acceptance: approved plan creates or updates task graph idempotently
each task has explicit success criteria
docs, tasks, artifacts, and runs share trace spine refs
materialization can be previewed before commit
anti_patterns: copying plan text into one task
success criteria hidden in prose only
manual_simulation: Approve plan with three work items, rerun materialization, and verify no duplicate tasks are created.
incentive: connects planning approval to executable project state

title: Freeform document context handoff into ACP planning
intent: When user begins in freeform docs, later ACP planning must import those docs as named context sources with excerpts and provenance.
acceptance: doc-to-ACP handoff lists source docs and selected sections
context bundle is inspectable before prompt send
doc edits after session start create new context version
agents can cite context source ids in plan output
anti_patterns: paste whole doc into prompt invisibly
stale doc content without version marker
context source not linked to trace
manual_simulation: Edit a freeform doc after initial plan, restart planning, and verify context version changes are visible.
incentive: preserves user-written intent across workflow modes

title: CLI parity for plan approval and feedback loops
intent: Expose plan review state, annotations, approval, and feedback from CLI so non-web users can complete the same workflow.
acceptance: CLI can list pending reviews as JSON
CLI can approve, block, or submit feedback with source refs
CLI output includes next action and trace id
CLI calls services/API rather than direct persistence
manual_simulation: Complete a plan feedback loop using CLI only and verify web shows identical review status.
incentive: keeps agent and terminal workflows first-class

title: TUI review queue with keyboard annotation workflow
intent: Provide a terminal review queue for plans, prototypes, UAT, and code review using keyboard-first navigation and structured feedback entry.
acceptance: TUI lists pending reviews by priority and type
keyboard shortcuts support approve, annotate, next item, previous item
annotations include source refs and severity
TUI uses service commands not direct ORM
anti_patterns: freeform notes not attached to source
manual_simulation: In TUI, reject a plan with one blocker and confirm web workbench shows the same annotation.
incentive: supports long-running agent supervision without leaving terminal

title: Bounded research steps persisted into planning artifacts
intent: Borrow Fusion-style research tools to let planning agents run bounded research and persist durable conclusions into task or plan documents.
acceptance: planning request can declare research questions and limits
research output is written to a durable artifact before decisions
plan cites research artifact ids
missing research provider records assumption rather than blocking silently
manual_simulation: Ask for ACP review plan, verify research artifact exists and plan item cites it before approval is possible.
incentive: keeps deep research from evaporating between sessions

title: Spec staleness detector before plan execution
intent: Detect when docs, prototypes, task criteria, or context changed after approval and require review refresh before execution continues.
acceptance: approved plan stores source content hashes or versions
execution checks for stale linked docs and artifacts
staleness result names changed sources and required action
user can refresh review or explicitly accept stale execution with reason
anti_patterns: running old plan after doc edits
manual_simulation: Approve plan, modify linked requirement doc, then run task and verify stale gate blocks with source diff summary.
incentive: prevents agents executing stale instructions

title: Planning triage assigns review depth and required evidence
intent: Classify planning/review requests by risk so Fulcrum can require prototype review, code review, UAT, security review, or lightweight approval appropriately.
acceptance: triage output names risk, required review types, and evidence requirements
high-risk tasks cannot skip code review or UAT without waiver
triage reason is visible in workbench
manual override records approver and reason
anti_patterns: same review process for typo and architecture change
manual_simulation: Submit auth-related plan and verify triage requires security/code review plus UAT evidence.
incentive: matches review ceremony to change risk

title: Agent job log panel tied to review feedback runs
intent: Show feedback-run status, logs, and result summaries in the review workbench so reviewers know whether requested changes were attempted and what happened.
acceptance: each feedback annotation can link to one or more agent jobs
log stream updates independently from editor state
job summary maps completed work back to original feedback
failed job offers retry or mark blocked
anti_patterns: failure shown only in server logs
manual_simulation: Submit three annotations, run feedback agent, and verify each annotation shows job status and result.
incentive: makes automated feedback loops inspectable

title: Contextual command palette for planning and review actions
intent: Use ACP UI and Plannotator command patterns to expose slash commands and keyboard actions for plan, review, UAT, traffic, and agent controls.
acceptance: palette filters available commands by current session state
commands show description, shortcut, and disabled reason
agent-provided slash commands and Fulcrum review commands coexist
keyboard navigation works without stealing text editor input
anti_patterns: global command list with invalid actions
keyboard shortcuts undocumented in UI state
slash commands sent as plain prompt accidentally
manual_simulation: In ACP planning input, type slash, choose submit plan command, then confirm it opens review flow not plain chat.
incentive: reduces mode confusion in dense workflows

title: Review artifacts lifecycle for plans, prototypes, logs, and evidence
intent: Store every plan, prototype, review export, UAT evidence, and ACP transcript fragment as trace-linked artifacts with retention and preview support.
acceptance: artifact records include kind, source run, subject, checksum, and trace spine
preview/download applies access checks
review export and UAT evidence are first-class artifact kinds
retention policy does not delete approved evidence without explicit policy
anti_patterns: artifact without trace to plan or run
manual_simulation: Attach UAT screenshot and review export, then verify both appear under same trace with preview and checksum.
incentive: makes workflow evidence durable and auditable

title: End-to-end trace spine from freeform doc to accepted regression test
intent: Every ACP planning, prototype, task execution, QA, UAT, code review, and generated E2E test must share trace refs so journey history is queryable.
acceptance: trace schema validates required links per entity kind
review and execution services reject orphaned run/artifact/memory refs
UI shows trace drawer for current workflow
generated E2E test metadata links back to UAT approval
anti_patterns: new ids with no parent trace
manual_simulation: Follow one workflow from doc to E2E generation and verify trace drawer lists each entity in order.
incentive: turns workflow history into navigable product memory

title: Mode and model selection with workflow policy hints
intent: ACP planning UI should let user choose mode and model while showing policy hints for when a task needs higher reasoning, code review, or cheaper mechanical execution.
acceptance: mode/model selectors reflect agent-reported capabilities
policy hints explain recommended mode for current review gate
selection changes are persisted per session
invalid mode/model combinations are blocked before send
anti_patterns: model choice detached from task risk
manual_simulation: Open high-risk review task, confirm recommended mode appears, change model, reload, and verify selection persists.
incentive: aligns agent effort with workflow risk

title: Agent startup progress and failure diagnostics
intent: Show startup phases, stderr excerpts, elapsed time, and recovery actions when an ACP-backed planning agent is launching.
acceptance: startup panel shows phase, elapsed time, and latest logs
stderr is redacted and bounded
cancel startup kills transport cleanly
retry preserves selected context and config
manual_simulation: Start agent with invalid command, confirm failure phase and actionable retry/cancel controls appear.
incentive: reduces dead-start confusion for local agent workflows

title: Search and navigation across review annotations and sources
intent: Enable reviewers to search plan text, diff files, prototype labels, annotations, and feedback statuses in one review session.
acceptance: search covers source content and annotation text
matches can jump to file, plan section, or artifact
filters include unresolved, blocker, author, and source kind
search state survives source switch
anti_patterns: annotation search separate from content search
manual_simulation: Create annotations across plan and diff, search one term, and verify jumps to both source kinds.
incentive: keeps large review sessions navigable

title: Reusable feedback templates for planning, UAT, and code review
intent: Provide structured feedback templates so reviewers can produce agent-actionable guidance without retyping common critique patterns.
acceptance: templates include missing criteria, stale context, prototype mismatch, test gap, and code risk
template output remains editable before submit
templates emit structured fields plus readable text
custom templates can be scoped by workspace or review type
anti_patterns: generic canned comments with no source refs
manual_simulation: Use missing-success-criteria template on a plan section and confirm exported feedback contains source range and requested fix.
incentive: raises feedback quality while reducing reviewer effort

title: Manual simulation checklist generated from acceptance criteria
intent: For every approved plan, generate manual simulation steps that exercise user-visible behavior before UAT or E2E test creation.
acceptance: simulation checklist derives from success criteria and user journey
each step has expected observation and evidence field
failed step can create feedback annotation
approved checklist seeds real-data E2E generation
anti_patterns: E2E generated before user-visible scenario is checked
manual_simulation: Approve a task workflow plan and confirm generated checklist covers setup, action, result, and regression-test handoff.
incentive: bridges abstract acceptance criteria to real user behavior

title: Cycle restart from ACP edits or manual document edits
intent: Let users restart planning or execution from changed ACP conversation state or edited docs without orphaning the previous cycle.
acceptance: changed source shows start new cycle action
new cycle links to prior cycle and changed sources
old approvals are preserved but marked superseded when needed
users can compare previous and new plan deltas
anti_patterns: editing docs mutates approved plan silently
new cycle loses prior review evidence
manual edits ignored by ACP planning
manual_simulation: Edit an approved requirement doc, start update cycle, and verify previous approval remains visible but no longer authorizes execution.
incentive: supports iterative work without losing audit history

title: Review workflow API parity for web, CLI, TUI, and external clients
intent: Expose the same planning/review/UAT/code-review actions through Nest HTTP and tRPC-backed callers so all surfaces share behavior.
acceptance: HTTP DTOs map to application service inputs without business logic in controller
tRPC caller exposes same action set
CLI/TUI use service/API callers not duplicated rules
contract tests cover web, CLI, TUI equivalent statuses
manual_simulation: Submit feedback via web, approve via CLI, and confirm HTTP review endpoint returns final approved state.
incentive: prevents fragmented workflow behavior across surfaces

title: Critique focus prompts embedded in review sessions
intent: Each review session should show focused critique prompts based on the item type so reviewers inspect the right risks, not only obvious UI defects.
acceptance: review session displays critique focus by area and risk
focus prompts can be checked as reviewed or converted into annotations
high-risk categories require explicit addressed or waived state
critique focus appears in exported review report
manual_simulation: Open ACP planning review and verify prompts include context provenance, prototype fidelity, and service boundary checks.
incentive: raises review rigor without relying on reviewer memory

title: Generate real-data E2E tests from approved UAT and code review evidence
intent: After approval, create regression test tasks and draft test specs using real scenario data captured during UAT/code review, never mocks by default.
acceptance: approved UAT evidence produces one or more test-generation tasks
generated test draft references exact scenario, fixture data, and evidence artifact ids
mock usage requires documented impossibility reason
test generation is blocked until UAT/code review is approved or explicitly waived
anti_patterns: generic smoke test from plan title
manual_simulation: Approve UAT with two evidence artifacts and verify generated test task cites both artifacts and concrete user data.
incentive: turns accepted behavior into durable regression coverage
